 Print Mohammed Shami, Sam Curran set for swap between LSG and Rajasthan Royals New Delhi: In what could be another major development before next month’s IPL auctions, Lucknow Super Giants are likely to trade Mohammed Shami to Rajasthan Royals in exchange for Sam Curran . TOI has learnt that talks are on between LSG and RR at an advanced stage. It is also learnt that RR have sought left-arm spinner M Siddharth from LSG. Shami, who recently retired from Test cricket, was traded to LSG from Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH) last year for Rs 10 crore. Royals had bought Curran for Rs 2.4 crore in last year auctions before he missed the entire season due to injury. Royals head coach Kumar Sangakkara had expressed his concerns when Curran turned up to play for Surrey during a domestic T20 tournament after having ruled himself out for the entire IPL season. Curran has been close to LSG director of cricket Tom Moody . LSG’s fast bowling pool already has the likes of Prince Yadav, Mayank Yadav and Mohsin Khan. LSG are looking to balance their playing XI through an allrounder albeit their batting is already heavily dependent on overseas batters like Mitchell Marsh, Aiden Markram and Nicholas Pooran.
